mapper.select:
SELECT COUNT(C.COMPANY_NUMBER) FROM TBL_COMPANY C JOIN TBL_COMP_INFO CI ON C.COMPANY_NUMBER = CI.COMPANY_NUMBER LEFT JOIN ( SELECT COMPANY_NUMBER, MAX(IFNULL(CAT1_IS_HIRING, 0)) AS CAT1_IS_HIRING, MAX(IFNULL(CAT2_IS_HIRING, 0)) AS CAT2_IS_HIRING, MAX(IFNULL(CAT3_IS_HIRING, 0)) AS CAT3_IS_HIRING, MAX(IFNULL(CAT4_IS_HIRING, 0)) AS CAT4_IS_HIRING FROM TBL_JOB_POST GROUP BY COMPANY_NUMBER ) JP ON C.COMPANY_NUMBER = JP.COMPANY_NUMBER WHERE C.COMPANY_STATE = '승인'
AND JP.CAT1_IS_HIRING = 1
AND JP.CAT2_IS_HIRING = 1
AND JP.CAT3_IS_HIRING = 1
AND JP.CAT4_IS_HIRING = 1

SELECT C.COMPANY_NUMBER AS companyNumber, C.COMPANY_NAME AS companyName, C.COMPANY_ADDRESS AS companyAddress, F.FILE_PATH AS filePath, CI.COMP_TYPE AS compType, CI.COMP_SUMMARY AS compSummary, DATE_FORMAT(IFNULL(CI.COMP_EDIT_DATE, CI.COMP_PAGE_DATE), '%Y-%m-%d') AS compPageDate, JP.CAT1_IS_HIRING AS cat1IsHiring, JP.CAT2_IS_HIRING AS cat2IsHiring, JP.CAT3_IS_HIRING AS cat3IsHiring, JP.CAT4_IS_HIRING AS cat4IsHiring FROM TBL_COMPANY C JOIN TBL_COMP_INFO CI ON C.COMPANY_NUMBER = CI.COMPANY_NUMBER LEFT JOIN ( SELECT COMPANY_NUMBER, MIN(FILE_NUMBER) AS FILE_NUMBER FROM TBL_FILE GROUP BY COMPANY_NUMBER ) FM ON C.COMPANY_NUMBER = FM.COMPANY_NUMBER LEFT JOIN TBL_FILE F ON FM.FILE_NUMBER = F.FILE_NUMBER LEFT JOIN ( SELECT COMPANY_NUMBER, MAX(IFNULL(CAT1_IS_HIRING, 0)) AS CAT1_IS_HIRING, MAX(IFNULL(CAT2_IS_HIRING, 0)) AS CAT2_IS_HIRING, MAX(IFNULL(CAT3_IS_HIRING, 0)) AS CAT3_IS_HIRING, MAX(IFNULL(CAT4_IS_HIRING, 0)) AS CAT4_IS_HIRING FROM TBL_JOB_POST GROUP BY COMPANY_NUMBER ) JP ON C.COMPANY_NUMBER = JP.COMPANY_NUMBER WHERE C.COMPANY_STATE = '승인'
AND JP.CAT1_IS_HIRING = 1
AND JP.CAT2_IS_HIRING = 1
AND JP.CAT3_IS_HIRING = 1
AND JP.CAT4_IS_HIRING = 1
ORDER BY C.COMPANY_NAME ASC, C.COMPANY_NUMBER DESC
ORDER BY IFNULL(CI.COMP_EDIT_DATE, CI.COMP_PAGE_DATE) DESC, C.COMPANY_NUMBER DESC
LIMIT #{offset}, #{rowCount}
